title: 对比学习中的锚点散度与语义几何
summary: 本文提出锚点散度（Anchor Divergences），通过对比学习、指数族与信息几何的相互作用，建立锚点概率分布与表示空间上Bregman几何之间的对应关系，从而在固定表示上指定上下文相关的语义几何，实验表明该方法能高效地指定特定情境下的语义相似度。
summary_en: This paper introduces Anchor Divergences, using the interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between anchor distributions and Bregman geometries on the representation space, enabling context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations, with retrieval experiments showing effectiveness and efficiency.
